supplemental.description: Official Slack documentation supplements absent from the pinned @slack/web-api 8.1.1 TypeScript snapshot. These entries are deliberately separate from extracted SDK declarations.

limits: Native scalar, array, and structural object fields are typed and hydrated recursively through six structural levels.
Polymorphic, indexed, and TypeScript-only fields remain raw rather than receiving an unsound PHP type.
All unknown response fields remain in Response::$data; all unknown request fields can be passed through Request::$extra.
